pages.text:
Menendez for Congress
It’s time to meet this moment
“It’s time to strengthen our families, empower our communities and build a future where we all succeed.
Please join me.”
## Meet Rob
Rob is the grandson of Cuban immigrants, who came to the United States with very little. They planted their American roots in Union City, where Rob was raised in a working-class community. His mother was a public school educator and his father, Senator Bob Menendez is a community and political leader throughout his childhood. His parents taught him the values and merit of public service. Now raising his daughter and son in Jersey City, Rob is running to strengthen families in the 8th District – strengthening all our families.

## Healthcare
We need to continue to expand access to affordable healthcare for every person in the 8th Congressional District and to protect a woman’s right to choose. The Affordable Care Act has provided access to healthcare to tens of millions of underinsured or uninsured individuals across the United States, including many in our district. While Republicans in Washington, D.C. continue to try their best to make healthcare harder to access through countless attempts to gut the ACA and through their dismantling of the protections long-afforded to women through Roe v. Wade., Democrats are working every day to expand the ACA and find meaningful solutions to the healthcare challenges facing our families. We must ensure that access to all forms of healthcare is protected and expanded. In Congress, I will fight to:
- Protect and expand the Affordable Care Act for the millions who rely on it every day;
- Lower the cost of quality health insurance coverage for all families in our district;
- Make sure that every American has access to the best medical care available regardless of ability to pay; and
- Codify Roe v. Wade and restore a woman’s fundamental reproductive right to have autonomy over her own body—period.
- Enact support legislation that protects a women’s ability to access medication that has made abortions safer and more accessible for those who have made that choice.
- Advocate to the FDA to lift restrictions and make it easier for women to obtain these medications through the mail so their reproductive choices are not limited by where they live or work.
- Repeal the Hyde Amendment, which only serves to make it harder for women of limited means to access abortions.

pages.title: Organized Labor - Rob Menendez
pages.text:
## Organized Labor
Unions have been a pathway to financial stability for so many working families, many of them immigrants to the United States. However, since the early 1980s, the unionization rate has fallen by nearly half, as unions have come under attack and the right to organize has been curtailed. I am proud of the broad support our campaign has earned from organized labor. As a Member of Congress, I will fight to:
- Uphold the right of our brothers and sisters in organized labor to organize for fair wages, safer working conditions, and respect for workers;
- Pass critical legislation like the PRO Act and the Public Service Freedom to Negotiate Act; and
- Support apprenticeship programs and other initiatives to train our workforce for well-paying union jobs that can lead to life-long careers and middle class opportunities.

pages.text:
## Immigration
Our immigrant families shape who we are as a community and I am privileged to represent a district that is strengthened by people from across the world. However, since President Trump took office, our communities have not been safe. They have been terrorized by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (“ICE”) and families have been torn apart across our district. Loved ones have disappeared into a cruel private detention system that puts profits over people at facilities like Delaney Hall and Elizabeth Detention Center. T hat is why I’ve been working to shut down private detention centers since coming to Congress.
In Congress, I have led our New Jersey Democratic delegation in efforts to stop the Department of Homeland Security (“DHS”) from detaining our neighbors at warehouse facilities and fought illegal restrictions on oversight of immigration detention centers. I saw firsthand ICE’s aggression and extreme tactics when my congressional oversight efforts led to a confrontation with more than 20 armed ICE and HSI agents at Delaney Hall in an incident that gained national attention.
I have also co-sponsored the Dignity for Detained Immigrants Act to end the use of private immigration detention facilities and prohibit family detention. I will continue to fight this Administration’s extreme anti-immigrant agenda and work to abolish ICE so we can finally end the abuses that our communities have faced.
As your Congressman, I will always protect the dream and promise of our country by:
- Fighting to abolish ICE.
- Working to close private detention centers and reunite families.
- Pushing to decriminalize immigration and end mass deportation.
- Fighting to protect Dreamers, TPS recipients, farmworkers, essential workers, and others.
- Ensuring our residents know their rights and can protect themselves and their families from ICE.
- Supporting real solutions for immigration reform, including a pathway to citizenship, humane border policies, and robust asylum protections.
